subject.title: fix(gateway): support native Windows exec approvals

question: Is the released Windows companion source contract plus Blacksmith integration coverage sufficient to merge this security-boundary PR without an exact-head native Windows run?
rationale: The code path touches exec approval policy reads/writes and generated protocol models, while the PR body explicitly says no fresh Windows lease was available for real native proof.

options.title: Require native Windows proof

options.title: Accept source-contract proof

options.title: Defer to the broader Windows PR
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve the approvals slice inside the broader Windows pairing and approvals branch if maintainers want one coordinated landing path.
